messages:
hazel: Quick sync  idea: ship a tiny OSS refapp + two short tutorials and tie into a 30min "mini-bench" livestream. Focus metric: "time-to-first-inference" for newcomers. Goal: drive repo stars, dev signups, and demo traffic.

omar: Nice. I can draft the launch post and a short case study box for the blog. Want to lead with a user story: "blogger shipped an assistant in 45 minutes" type hook.

jin: DevRel will scaffold the repo. Constraints: single Dockerfile, tiny deps, and one-click run for the bench. Plan a baseline + quantized run and include a results CSV. ETA 4 business days.

hazel: Routing plan: webinar/recording signups -> form asks "Company size" and "Primary use". If company size > 100 -> SDR. If user selects "building product" -> tag for product trial email. Otherwise nurture sequence with repo howto.

omar: UTM pattern suggestion: utm_source=oss_refkit&utm_medium={channel}&utm_campaign=minibench_launch&utm_content={variant}. Keep consistent across blog, tweet, and email.

samir: Marketing ops note: please include a hidden input that captures utm_content so we can trace which social variant converts best. Also please add source mapping to HubSpot list.

jin: Repo README run example I'll add: ```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/spark-refapp.git
cd spark-refapp
docker build -t spark-refapp .
docker run --rm -e MODEL=base spark-refapp ./bench.sh --iters 30 --seq 256
```
I'll include a GitHub Action that runs `docker build` on PRs and validates the bench script exists.

hazel: For the mini-bench livestream: format 10m demo, 10m walk-through of the bench results, 10m Q&A. Keep it informal and show how to reproduce locally. Limit to 120 seats and record.

omar: Draft headlines: "Spark Refapp: ship a tiny inference demo in under an hour" or "Reproducible inference: a tiny refapp and a mini-benchmark". I like the second since it's more technical.

samir: For inbound routing, suggest this sequence: registrant -> enrich via Clearbit (company size) -> if enterprise -> SDR sequence with 3-touch cadence; else -> automated email with repo + trial. Add a leaderboard metric to show which channels produce engaged engineers (stars + PRs).

jin: I'll add sample prompts for the bench and a small JSON file with expected output for smoke checks. That will help QA.

hazel: Action items: Omar - blog + social drafts + UTM. Jin - repo skeleton + CI + smoke data. Samir - routing + CRM mapping. Me (Hazel) - webinar ops + recording + Asana epic. React with :white_check_mark: to accept.

product-bot: Reminder: webinar checklist template -> https://docs.internal/redwood/webinars/mini-checklist

omar: :white_check_mark: I'll post drafts in #marketing-drafts tomorrow.
jin: :white_check_mark: starting repo today.
samir: :white_check_mark: will share CRM mapping and Clearbit enrichment flow by Wed.
hazel: Thanks team  I'll create the calendar invite and tag infra for any compute on the day.
